claims.statement: Management targets general merchandise and apparel (GMA) contribution trend lines around the current run rate of approximately 23%.
claims.quote: A broad trend line will be around the current run rates of around 23%, is the sense we get.

claims.statement: Management expects store openings to scale from approximately 40 to 60 or 70 per year in the next two to three years.
claims.quote: in another two to three years, this 40 should go to a 60 or a 70 per year.

claims.statement: The company maintains a North Star target for new store openings of 10% to 15% of the existing store count.
claims.quote: typically 10% to 15% of my number count should be my new store opening, broadly.

facts.statement: Total retail business area at the end of fiscal '24 reached approximately 15.1 million square feet, with 1.8 million square feet opened in the current year.
facts.quote: The total retail business area at the end of the fiscal '24 was about 15.1 million square feet. We opened 1.8 million square feet area in the current year.

facts.statement: Standalone revenue from operations for FY24 was INR49,533 crores, with an EBITDA margin of 8.3% and PAT of INR2,695 crores.
facts.quote: The revenue from operations as disclosed earlier is INR49,533 crores, delivered in the stand-alone business. EBITDA margin of 8.3%, so almost INR4,100 crores of EBITDA. We delivered 5.4% PAT, about INR2,695 crores.

facts.statement: The company has no traditional financial debt on its balance sheet, with reported debt representing Ind AS 116 lease disclosures.
facts.quote: Debt and equity, we all know we don't have debt, but the debt that you see on the balance sheet is about the Ind AS 116 disclosure

facts.statement: Net cash flow from operations for the standalone business was INR3,343 crores in FY24.
facts.quote: And the net cash flow from operations of INR3,343 crores.

facts.statement: Subsidiary Avenue E-commerce delivered a 31.7% sales increase close to INR2,900 crores with a loss of INR185 crores.
facts.quote: Avenue E-commerce delivered a 31.7% sales increase, close to INR2,900 crores and we had a loss of INR185 crores
